stem.text: What is the major product formed when compound R is warmed with an excess of HBr?

stem.label: R
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of compound R: a cyclohexene ring with a methyl group on one alkene carbon, a ring carbon bearing both a methyl group and an OH group, and an adjacent ring carbon bearing a CH2OH group.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring bearing three Br atoms, including a CH2Br side chain.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring bearing two Br atoms and one OH group, including a CH2Br side chain.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring bearing one Br atom and two OH groups, including a CH2OH side chain.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring bearing three Br atoms, including a CH2Br side chain.
